english.title: Publish advertisement for apparatus to be supplied failing to comply with s. 73 requirement - wireless telegraphy
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) published an advertisement for apparatus to be supplied in the course of a trade or business and the advertisement failed to comply with a requirement imposed by an order under section 73 of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 2006
english.legislation: Contrary to section 74(3) and (4) of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 2006.

english.notes:
(i) Section 75 of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 2006 provides for cases where the commission of this offence by one person is due to the act or default of another person.
(ii) Section 76 of the Act provides that advertisement includes a catalogue, a circular and a price list.
(iii) Section 107 of the Act provides for proceedings and enforcement regarding this offence.
(iv) Section 110 of the Act provides for criminal liability of company directors, managers, etc.
(v) The Wireless Telegraphy (Fixed Penalty) Regulations 2011, (In force 01/10/2011), introduces a £100-00p fixed penalty charge for summary only offences under the Act, as from that date. This regime does not include offences relating to illegal broadcasting (pirate radio).
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant published an advertisement for apparatus to be supplied in the course of a trade or business and the advertisement failed to comply with a requirement imposed by an order under section 73 of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 2006.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
12 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
